title: Korea Semiconductors

passages.note: Section on TSMC and Samsung Foundry EUV adoption. The analysts report that TSMC began N7 mass production using argon fluoride immersion lithography in the first half of 2018. The section discusses N7+ separately as the later EUV insertion.

lineage: Industry analysis produced outside TSMC. It gives no independent wafer measurements or per-layer process flow.
